The ecology direction retains a continuous biodiversity/conservation/evolution/ecosystem/marine/farming strand tied to the exact target’s Environment and Sustainability domain. The human route sustains molecular, physiological, disease and neural inquiry while making its psychological complement explicit.
targetComparability.judgment: Retain all three. Unlike CP119’s broadened cultural-meaning composition, the biological object of inquiry is materially pursued. General coherence alone did not establish this judgment. No matching threshold or disciplinary-equivalence test used.
